mapper.select: SELECT m.workspace_id, m.user_id, m.role, m.created_at, u.display_name, u.username FROM workspace_member m JOIN app_user u ON u.id = m.user_id WHERE m.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} ORDER BY CASE WHEN m.role = 'owner' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, u.display_name, u.id
SELECT user_id FROM workspace_member WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO workspace_member (workspace_id, user_id, role) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{userId}, #{role})
mapper.update: UPDATE workspace_member SET role = #{role} WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM workspace_member WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND user_id = #{userId}
